title: A failing candidate must not change the target ref
description: An agent publishes a candidate commit whose required payment test fails.

agents.label: agent-a
agents.intent: Introduce PaymentProvider routing and preserve the existing default

ground_truth.rationale: This scenario evaluates lifecycle and Git gating rather than intent conflict.

success_criteria: The validation result is persisted with its command, exit status, and candidate fingerprint.
The ChangeSet cannot transition to accepted or committed while validation fails.
The target Git ref is identical before and after the rejected attempt.
The failed result remains queryable as provenance.
